subject: general
question: Who was also known as Rabia-ud-Daurani?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dilras Banu Begum**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dilras Banu Begum **was the **first wife **and **chief consort **of **Emperor Aurangzeb**, the **sixth Mughal emperor**.
 
• **She **is also **known by **her **posthumous title**, **Rabia-ud-Daurani**.
 
• **The Bibi Ka Maqbara **in **Aurangabad**, which **bears a striking **resemblance to the **Taj Mahal**, was commissioned by her husband to act as her **final resting place**.
 
• She was **born in 1622 **in **Daulatabad Fort**, **Kesapuri Tanda **and **died **on **8 October 1657 **in **Aurangabad**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asmat Begum **was **the wife **of **Mirza Ghias Beg**, the **Prime minister of the Mughal emperor Jahangir**, and the **mother of Mughal empress Nur Jahan, the power behind the emperor.**
 
• **Nur Jahan**, **born Mehr-un-Nissa **was the **chief wife **and **empress consort **of **the Mughal emperor Jahangir**. She was the **twentieth **and **last wife of Jahangir**.
 
• **Manavati Bai **better known by her title, **Jagat Gosain**, was the **second wife **and the **empress consort **of the **fourth Mughal emperor Jahangir **and the **mother of his successor, Shah Jahan.**
